about: Downlink: which space filings send signals down towards the ground. A filing goes on if it is a satellite with at least one transmitting group; only its transmitting groups go on with it.

satellite_types.G: Geostationary satellite: stays fixed in the sky
satellite_types.N: Non-geostationary satellite: moves across the sky

reasons.not_satellite: It is a station on the ground, not a satellite. Ground stations are checked separately, not in this screen.
reasons.nothing_filed: It is a satellite, but it files nothing that transmits or receives.
reasons.receive_only: It is a satellite, but it only receives. Nothing it files is sent down to the ground.

notes: Reasons are tried in the order above; a filing gets the first that is true.
notice.ntc_type gives the kind of station; grp.emi_rcp says whether a group transmits (E) or receives (R).
